g.text: Time from upload click to a usable video

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526579

g.text: 600 measured uploads · Same processing DAG · Observed readiness includes polling and playback startup
Bars: p95. Whiskers: 95% wave-bootstrap intervals. Ratios use paired waves; concurrent clients stay together.
Synthetic speech on one isolated host; household networks, production SLOs and reliability are not established.
